reviews.title: Fun and tasty craft candy
reviews.body: These fun candy snack kits have provided a great deal of entertainment for the kids. They love the taste too and love finding out what flavors the items taste like when made (usually fruity). The craft aspect has them learning to follow directions and careful thinking about each step, depending on their goal of what they are trying to make. It has been fun helping them and then watching as they began tackling each project on their own. So far I think they have done about half the kits (we actually had found two individual ones at the supermarket before I found this assortment, so they had some extra experience). They are very creative and it is always neat seeing how various items are made from powders and water, like the salmon roe or ramen noodles.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on November 24, 2025
reviews.author: A. Silva-Sadder

reviews.title: Tons of fun I promise!
reviews.body: For sheer entertainment value alone, I’d give this product ten stars. It’s FUN.I bought it for my nieces, but my SIL and I ended up being the ones who actually made the “candy.” (Yes, those are ironic quotations.) we laughed, we bonded. She took pictures, but never sent me any.My 10-year-old niece was the only one who actually attempted to eat the “candy” beyond one bite. I found it simultaneously too sweet and yet flavorless. I believe my exact words were “it tastes like sadness.” SIL was incredulous. “Wait, it’s EDIBLE?” Theoretically, yes it is. If you are 10 or younger, t is apparently the nectar of the gods. We had to wrestle it away from youngest niece lest she slip into a diabetic coma, and she said “aw man!” sadly as I tossed out the finished product.The instructions were clear, the packages came with everything you need minus water, and the “candy” looked like it did on the outside of the box, which almost never happens. I feel like it would have been easy for children, but unfortunately only my SIL and I were interested in actually making them.These kits are seriously so much fun. Please do get them.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 30, 2021
reviews.author: Heidi Michelle

reviews.body: These actually taste pretty good.  My son loves to do them and we have a lot of fun creating them together.  It's a fun activity that kills about 30 minutes of the day.

reviews.title: Tastes bleh but fun for the kids
reviews.body: If you're thinking you're gonna get a dessert out of these gummy/mush creations, prepare yourself. It was just what we expected and my kids had fun giggling while making some of the creations. They laughed when they told me I should have a taste. The kids had a blast and that's what matters.

reviews.author: Just Me

reviews.title: A favorite stocking stuffer
reviews.body: I get a pile of these every year for my child.  She's a teenager now, but these are the one thing she always asks for.  The kits don't take long, and by now she's done all of the different varieties many times, but it doesn't mean she doesn't love them.  It's much cheaper to get a lot of them this way than separately, so I get her enough for the year in winter, and she has them whenever she wants.  The instructions are clear even if they are in a different language, and the steps are simple enough.  Usually the end result is fairly tasty, although definitely full of artificial candy flavors.  The more savory kits become a risk when making them, because some are oddly enjoyable, some aren't bad, and some will create taste nightmares.  As a rainy day kit, or something for kids to do with grandparents and relatives, these are great, but I might not look at this as a party activity due to the chance of getting packets mixed up or spills.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 5, 2024
reviews.author: Rebecca Kirk

reviews.title: These are so fun for kids, even the older one thinks it's fun!
reviews.body: I originally saw these when Safiya did a video about them. I thought my kids might think they were fun...turned out I was spot on. They have such a fun time getting the kit all set up and following the steps and seeing how their little creations turn out. Most of the ones we've tried come out looking really realistic. And surprisingly...most of it actually tastes pretty good (from the few little bites they've allowed me to try!) Who would have guessed that coke flavored gummy ramen would be such a big hit?!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on March 30, 2022
reviews.author: Agent_Cooper

reviews.title: Very cute & fun, not yummy
reviews.body: My kids had a ton of fun preparing these little candies. All but one were uneaten entirely though — they found the texture and flavors gross. If you think of it like a disposable art project, that makes sense.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 15, 2020
reviews.author: cat c.

reviews.title: Weird but super fun
reviews.body: I found one of these for sale at my local supermarket and had so much fun making the one kit with my husband, that found them here and I ordered this set.  It’s awesome.  Like weirdly awesome.  We’ve only done a couple so far (saving for a rainy day) but so far every one has had really clear directions and some of the flavors have been weird, but tasted good.  The kits are well made and I do highly recommend.If you don’t like following directions, don’t order this kit.  You do have to be precise to mix the little powders and stuff, so if you’re into things like building ikea bookcases and assembling complicated Lego sets, you will love this kit.  I hope whoever makes these comes out with more different kits, because we’ll totally order them all.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 22, 2020
reviews.author: Sarah M
